drafts.title: Nice Furniture
drafts.pitch: Same idea; Cursor hangs a bell on the stand and rings it, and nobody comes anyway.
drafts.reason: The bell fix plus 'Nice furniture' pays off the pitcher's note, but it spends the strongest line, 'No bell', and the ending explains the joke instead of delivering a verdict.

drafts.title: Open
drafts.pitch: Same idea; Cursor offers to be the first customer and is told the room doesn't count.
drafts.reason: 'You're in the room. That doesn't count.' is a good line, but Tilde's 'No bell' then lands as a tag with nothing leading to it; two endings compete.
